45254.title: Add Part: cannot enter a custom Cost for an inventory part

blocks: You are NOT allowed to enter a custom Cost for an inventory part — the Cost field is not editable; the cost comes from the catalogue. (You can still set the Sell price and the other allowed fields.)---Source: Manually added (QA lead, 2026-09-01).
